FEAT-5-S128.title: Tool Schema and Contract Definition
FEAT-5-S128.description: Define and standardize tool schemas using Pydantic models, including input/output contracts for all allowlisted tools to ensure consistent validation and dispatch behavior.

FEAT-5-S129.title: Tool Router Integration with Chat API
FEAT-5-S129.description: Integrate the tool_router into the FastAPI main chat loop, ensuring tool_use blocks from the LLM are correctly intercepted, routed through the allowlist, and responses injected back into the conversation.

FEAT-5-S130.title: Unit Tests for Allowlist and Validation Logic
FEAT-5-S130.description: Create unit tests validating allowlist enforcement, correct Pydantic validation behavior, and rejection of malformed or unauthorized tool calls.

FEAT-5-S131.title: End-to-End Tool Routing Integration Tests
FEAT-5-S131.description: Implement integration tests simulating LLM tool_use responses to verify full routing flow, including validation, dispatch, execution, and response reinjection into chat history.
